title: K-flat affine pullback chart comparison
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], $A=\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$, $B=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$, and $\varphi=f^\sharp:A\to B$. Let $P$ be a K-flat complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Then $Lf^*Q((Y\to\operatorname{Spec} A)^*\widetilde P)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is isomorphic to the exact derived restriction along $X\to\operatorname{Spec} B$ of $Q(\widetilde{B\otimes_A P})$ [def-pc-derived-category]. The localization on $\operatorname{Spec} B$ may have an independent universe. This computes pullback of a given model, without an existence assertion for a representative of an arbitrary object.

proof.text: Naturality of toSpecΓ gives the commutative square f;Y.toSpecΓ = X.toSpecΓ;Spec.map(f.appTop). Restriction along either canonical chart is an exact equivalence of module categories.

Use the literal-spectrum affine formula derivedPullback_tilde_iso on the identity resolution of P. Tilde(P) is K-flat, so its derived pullback is computed termwise and identified with tilde of extension of scalars.

Tensor pullback commutes with restriction along the chart isomorphisms, by its inverse-image and change-of-rings formula. Chart restriction preserves K-flatness since it is a ringed-space isomorphism. Evaluate the counit of exists_derivedPullback on the chart-restricted K-flat complex; it is invertible. These identifications and the square of step 1 transport the spectrum formula to f. The exact restriction localization factors give the displayed right-hand side. If the spectrum localization universe differs, the canonical equivalence between the two localizations transports the same factors; uniqueness of localization lifts identifies their comparisons.

theorem affine_kFlat_pullback_chart_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).toRingedSpace))]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, ⊤)) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, ⊤)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P) :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback f).obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).toRingedSpace) ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.toSpecΓ))
          (by change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.toSpecΓ).PreservesZeroMorphisms
              infer_instance) (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
              (@id (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, ⊤) ⥤
                SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).toRingedSpace))
                (tilde.functor Γ(Y, ⊤))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj P))) ≅
        (@Functor.mapDerivedCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).toRingedSpace) ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.toSpecΓ))
          (by change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.toSpecΓ).Additive; infer_instance)
          (by change PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.toSpecΓ)
              infer_instance)
          (by change PreservesFiniteColimits (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.toSpecΓ)
              infer_instance)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
                (@id (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤) ⥤
                  SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).toRingedSpace))
                  (tilde.functor Γ(X, ⊤))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj
                  (((ModuleCat.extendScalars f.appTop.hom).mapHomologicalComplex
                    (.up ℤ)).obj P))))
